baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered verbs جَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰ move from gathering to containing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Scattered property is first consolidated into one stock and then put into a vessel; the prefixed fa supplies the sequential arrow from acquisition to enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered parts into one whole supplies the acquisition and concentration stage.
Holding a thing in a vessel supplies the subsequent storage and closure stage.

changed_reading.before: A person collected and stored things.
changed_reading.after: The pair depicts a two-stage stockpiling pipeline: draw dispersed goods inward, then enclose and retain them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus verbs can operate on what is brought together and retained inwardly, not only on goods.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dispersed thoughts are gathered into a firm decision and the resulting meaning is held in the heart; fa turns deliberative concentration into inward fixation.

activation_trace.role: Concerted resolve that gathers thought into one decision supplies mental consolidation.
Holding a meaning in the heart supplies durable inward retention of that resolve.

changed_reading.after: It can also model an inwardly consolidated resolve: thought is narrowed into one purpose and kept closed within.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The gathering root includes the clenched hollow of a hand, while the second root supplies a vessel.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hand becomes a first container by closing around what it acquires, and the vessel becomes a second container; the pair therefore marks a posture of clutching before caching.

activation_trace.role: The clenched hollow of the hand supplies a bodily image of acquisition through grip.
The vessel supplies a second enclosure that extends the closed hand into a cache.

changed_reading.before: The problem is the quantity accumulated.
changed_reading.after: The pair foregrounds a double closure, clutch then cache, so the possessive grip matters as much as the amount.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Gathering scattered parts can feed the second root's image of a bone knitting after fracture.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fragments are recollected and then knit into regained strength, including the possibility of a crooked mend; this leaves the gather-and-hold architecture ethically neutral until context distinguishes repair from hoarding.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered parts into one whole supplies the recollection of fragments.
Bone knitting after a break supplies consolidation as repair, while allowing an imperfect mend.

changed_reading.before: Every act of gathering and holding is possessive accumulation.
changed_reading.after: The same root sequence can describe restorative recollection, although context must decide whether the consolidation heals or merely hardens.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus promises security by making a whole and enclosing it, but the preceding cosmic scene turns even the overhead order into molten residue and a solid aggregate into soft fiber. The large-scale transformations reverse the imagined permanence of the small stockpile.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without scattering or loss supplies the stockpiler's desired permanence.
Holding a thing in a vessel supplies the attempted stable enclosure.
Molten substances and residues make the sky image fluid, destabilizing the idea of a permanent container.
A solid elevated aggregate supplies the scene's strongest image of concentrated permanence.
Soft dyed wool supplies the dispersible state into which that solid aggregate is transformed.

structural_cues: The parallel becoming clauses in 70:8-9 move from sky to mountains and from apparent solidity to fluid or fiber.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies molten or residual sky and a solid aggregate becoming soft wool; I infer a macro-scale reversal of the focus's gather-and-contain strategy. A live alternative is that the transformations only stage the judgment scene without targeting accumulation specifically.

changed_reading.before: Gathering and enclosing create a durable reserve.
changed_reading.after: The reserve is an illusion of solidity: even the largest apparent wholes can liquefy or loosen into fiber.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wished-for ransom expands from close relations and the sheltering group to everyone on earth. Against that sequence, gathering and containing become a possessive inventory logic that can reduce persons, protection, and world to reserves exchangeable for the self.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without loss supplies the collector's drive toward an exhaustive inventory.
The vessel supplies a bounded reserve into which the inventory is conceptually placed.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the exchange and substitution logic.
Joining a sheltering collective supplies a protective relation that the ransom wish recasts as reserve.
Wholeness without scattering or loss makes the earth's total population the maximal imagined inventory.

structural_cues: 70:11-14 expands the proposed ransom from sons through spouse, brother, sheltering clan, and finally everyone on earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit ransom, an ordered kin-to-all expansion, shelter, and totality; I infer that the accumulator's possessive logic treats relations as convertible reserve. Alternatively, the list may depict only panic under punishment rather than the prior logic of the collector.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns a stockpile of material goods.
changed_reading.after: It exposes a totalizing inventory mentality capable of treating even relationships and the whole social world as assets held for self-preservation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fire calls a person characterized by turning the back and turning away, after which the focus names gathering and storing. The sequence aligns outward relational refusal with inward material flow: what is not answered or released is redirected into the closed store.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered parts into one whole supplies the inward movement of acquisition.
Holding a thing in a vessel supplies the terminal closure of that inward movement.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the outward summons against which closure is measured.
Turning the back supplies a bodily and relational vector away from the summons.
Turning away supplies sustained disengagement that pairs with retaining goods inward.

structural_cues: 70:17-18 places two retreat predicates immediately before the coordinated gather-then-store pair, with the fire as caller.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a call, two forms of turning away, and the gather-store sequence; I infer opposing vectors of relational withdrawal and material intake. A live alternative is that turning away and stockpiling are separate symptoms rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The stockpile is a morally isolated possession.
changed_reading.after: The stockpile is relational closure: the person turns away from an outward claim while drawing goods inward and sealing them there.

context_deltas.mechanism: An anxious, greedy disposition reacts to adverse contact with collapsed patience and to beneficial contact by withholding the hand. This supplies a feedback model in which panic motivates accumulation and withholding preserves the resulting store.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed parts into a stock supplies the acquisitive response to insecurity.
Holding goods in a vessel supplies the retained buffer that withholding maintains.
Anxious greed and rapid disturbance supply the unstable disposition driving the cycle.
Being reached by an effect supplies the contact event that triggers a reaction.
Patience being cut off supplies the panic response to adverse contact.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the retention response when good arrives.

structural_cues: 70:19 states a disposition, and 70:20-21 repeat the same conditional contact frame before the opposed panic and withholding outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies anxious greed, contact, broken patience, and a hand withheld from giving; I infer that panic drives acquisition while withholding maintains the cache. Alternatively, these may be co-listed traits without a causal loop between them.

changed_reading.before: Gathering and storing are two isolated acts of greed.
changed_reading.after: They are the middle of a self-reinforcing threat-control cycle: fear accumulates a buffer and withholding keeps it sealed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later description locates a fixed entitlement inside wealth and identifies both requester and deprived recipient. The material container is therefore not claim-proof: righteous holding preserves an outlet, while the focus stockpile suppresses circulation by treating enclosure as absolute title.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered property into one whole supplies the accumulated wealth under dispute.
Holding goods in a vessel supplies the bounded store that must remain open to claims.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth names the material domain of the focus stockpile.
A fixed obligatory entitlement inserts an enforceable claim within what appears privately held.
Asking and requesting supply a named outward demand upon the stored wealth.
Deprivation and loss supply the excluded recipient whose lack tests the store's closure.

structural_cues: 70:24 places a known right inside their wealth, and 70:25 immediately specifies the asker and the deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth containing a fixed right and two recipient classes; I infer that the right functions as an outlet through the focus vessel rather than as an optional gift from outside it. Alternatively, the later verses may regulate only righteous holdings and simply contrast the condemned accumulator.

changed_reading.before: The vice is owning a large enclosed quantity.
changed_reading.after: The decisive vice is treating the enclosure as free of others' fixed claims; legitimate holding remains permeable to distribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second focus root can name a caretaker, while the later exception couples a deposited charge or covenant with guardian-like preservation. This bifurcates containment into self-sealed possession and accountable custody: the same holding architecture changes character when answerable to an external trust.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed contents supplies the practical act shared by possession and custody.
The orphan caretaker supplies a form of holding defined by responsibility rather than ownership.
A prior charge deposited for safekeeping supplies content held under an external instruction.
A guardian's preservation of flock or subjects supplies accountable management of what is held.

structural_cues: 70:32 coordinates trusts and covenant as objects of an ongoing guarding predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a caretaker branch, a deposited charge, and guardian-like preservation; I infer that answerability to another's claim distinguishes custody from hoarding. Alternatively, 70:32 may only contrast good conduct and may not rehabilitate any shade of the focus actor's storing.

changed_reading.before: Containment itself is equivalent to hoarding.
changed_reading.after: Containment divides ethically: custody holds for another under obligation, whereas hoarding converts held contents into absolute self-possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus actor gathers contents into a vessel, but the finale has people pass out of grave-containers and rush as a mass toward one erected target. Subject and object reverse: the accumulator who controlled enclosure becomes contained material extracted and swept into a larger gathering.

activation_trace.role: A gathering day or summons supplies the larger event that can gather the former collector.
The vessel supplies the container relation that the grave scene later reverses.
Passing to the outside supplies the emptying or extraction movement from enclosure.
The grave supplies the containing space from which the human contents emerge.
Speed as the opposite of slowness turns retained bodies into a rapidly moving mass.
An erected prominent object supplies the common target toward which the extracted mass converges.

structural_cues: 70:43 uses plural emergence and rushing around a single destination, converting many separated grave interiors into one directed crowd.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence from graves, rapid movement, and a common erected target; I infer a reversal of the focus's container roles. A live alternative is that this is only the surah's general resurrection endpoint rather than a specific counter-image to hoarding.

changed_reading.before: The accumulator is the agent who controls contents and container.
changed_reading.after: The accumulator is finally a contained body extracted from its grave and gathered into a movement larger than any private store.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the second focus root's medical image of a wound filling with pus through the nearby stripping of bodily extremities. It remains anchored in أَوْعَىٰ and in branch-backed bodily context, but downstream prose should present it only as a pathological-containment analogy, never as the verse's lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The second focus root supplies harmful matter collecting inside a wound, while the first supplies the gathering motion.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered matter supplies the inward accumulation stage of the bodily analogy.
A wound filling with pus supplies storage as pathological retention rather than preservation.
Uprooting a thing from its seat supplies violent removal that exposes what was held.
Extremities and nonfatal bodily parts supply the corporeal site for the stripping image.

changed_reading.before: Storage preserves something valuable against loss.
changed_reading.after: In the outlier analogy, inward storage becomes an infected filling whose retained contents are themselves corruption exposed by stripping.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ء ل to س ل ل mapping and its image of drawing something out gently. It remains useful because the focus explicitly supplies a vessel and 70:24 supplies an obligatory claim, but downstream prose must mark it as a cross-root material analogy, not an etymology or lexical sense of سائل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus vessel can be imagined as opened by an authorized drawing-out motion from the later asker sequence.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed goods into one stock supplies the contents available for withdrawal.
Holding goods in a vessel supplies the enclosure from which contents must be drawn.
A fixed obligatory entitlement supplies authorization for withdrawal from the store.
Drawing something out gently or secretly supplies the exploratory extraction motion that reopens the vessel.

changed_reading.before: The asker stands outside the store and merely requests a discretionary gift.
changed_reading.after: The asker becomes an authorized extraction channel that draws accumulated contents back out of enclosure and into circulation.

strongest_changes: 70:17 recasts gathering and storage as inward closure paired with turning away from an outward call.
70:19-21 turns the pair into a threat-response loop in which panic motivates accumulation and withholding preserves it.
70:24-25 inserts a fixed claim and named recipients inside wealth, shifting the contrast from quantity to sealed possession versus circulation.
70:43 reverses container control by making the accumulator a body extracted from a grave and gathered into a larger movement.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots share a gather-and-contain architecture across goods, thought, grip, repair, crowd, and wound. Context repeatedly reverses or ethically differentiates that architecture instead of merely attaching a general theme of greed.
remaining_uncertainties: The cognitive and reparative focus-only branches may be diagnostic analogies rather than live readings of these verbal forms.
The kin-ransom sequence may characterize the accumulator's possessive logic, or it may depict only panic under judgment.
The resurrection container reversal may be a specific counter-image to hoarding or only a broader surah-scale echo.
The س ء ل to س ل ل extraction outlier depends on a non-dominant mapping and must not be rendered as lexical equivalence.
